//: Single source of truth for the host the Help Center is published on. Read by astro.config.mjs (site URL), src/components/Head.astro (canonical, og:url, JSON-LD, GA4 linker), worker.js (robots.txt, indexability, legacy-host redirects), and scripts/generate-og.py (share-image footer label). Changing hosts is this file plus `npm run og -- --force && npm run build && npx wrangler deploy` and a wrangler.toml route.
//academy: The Academy tab (src/lib/academy.mjs). `open: false` keeps the tab out of the header and the "Learn this in Academy" cards off articles; /academy itself still builds, so staff can open it directly. Set true once our org's Learning Site is synced in prod and web-api has HELP_ACADEMY_SITE (sessionboard-tam docs/strategy/sessionboard-academy-help-center.md §6).
//retiredApiDocsHosts: The retired Mintlify API docs. wrangler.toml routes them to this Worker (a zone route on the existing proxied CNAME, no DNS change) and worker.js 301s every path to its /api page (src/lib/api-docs/retired-host.mjs).
//internalPrefix: URL prefix of the staff-only enablement section (src/pages/<internalPrefix>/). Unlisted: noindex header + meta, excluded from sitemap, search, llms.txt and robots.txt, never linked from a public page (scripts/check-internal.mjs). Must match the directory name under src/pages/.
//staffOnly: Sections built and deployed like any page but visible only to signed-in Sessionboard staff (super users), with a lock in the sidebar and on the page — Registration, Expo, Onsite and the Attend mobile app are not released to customers, and Enablement is the CS view of releases. `prefixes` are route-slug prefixes, `pages` single slugs. Everyone else gets a 404 and no sidebar entry, link, search hit, sitemap/llms entry or Team Lead chunk (src/lib/staff-only.mjs lists every surface). Remove a section from here to make it public.
//signedInOnly: Readable by any signed-in Sessionboard user, never public (Josh, 2026-11-14: the Help Center is open to everyone and every crawler, except anything about registration, lead scanning, check-in, badges, Expo or other surfaces Cvent would find competitive). Same plumbing as staffOnly (src/lib/staff-only.mjs): kept out of search, the sitemap, llms*.txt, the public OpenAPI spec (apiTags) and the HTML the public gets; worker.js serves them to signed-in readers. scripts/check-restricted-terms.mjs fails the build when a public page mentions these subjects. Ask Josh before moving anything out of this list.
//account: Signed-in readers (src/lib/account-session.mjs). The product (admin app, speaker portal, Ready Room) mints a read-only Help Center token from its region's API and POSTs it to /_account/session from one of the `regions` app origins; the Worker keeps it in an HttpOnly cookie and reads who the reader is, their roles and their orgs/events through it. `signInPath` is the product page that does that hand-off. `guides` are the pages the header's "For you" list shows for each role, in order (src/components/ForYou.astro); organizers read the whole site.
